description: Use when hunting Hyperliquid funding extremes or carry trades with filters. Ranked by funding, OI, volume, basis, premium or 24h change. Input: optional sort, order, limit (1-50), min_oi_usd, min_volume_usd, funding (positive/negative), min_abs_apr. Output: rows (1h + annualized funding, OI, volume, basis, premium), top/bottom 5. Plain funding list: /v1/crypto/hyperliquid/markets?sort=funding. Example: ?sort=funding&min_abs_apr=20&limit=20 Price: $0.009 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

funding.description: Funding sign filter (positive = longs pay shorts)

min_abs_apr.description: Only markets whose |annualized Hyperliquid funding| >= this percent

min_oi_usd.description: Only markets with open interest >= this many USD

min_volume_usd.description: Only markets with 24h notional volume >= this many USD

sort.description: Ranking field (default funding = 1h funding rate; arb_spread is retired and sorts by funding)

name: hl_funding_screener
title: Find funding extremes and carry trades: all Hyperliquid perps ranked by funding, OI, volume, basis and premium
